_meta.origin: Refinement of user's JSON #3 (Bullish Momentum Launchpad variant, OI-Trend-Magnet-Scalper)
fixes_applied_vs_v1: replaced 'green candle + price > EMA9' cold entry with pullback + reclaim pattern
raised OI bias threshold from 1.20 to 1.50 and restricted to focus zone
added ADX trend-regime gate and VIX ceiling
2-candle confirmation for partial exit instead of single candle close
added time window, position sizing, strike selection, DTE handling, daily risk caps

sentiment.source: option chain focus zone = ATM ± 3 strikes

metrics.put_oi_change: Σ ΔOI of PE in focus zone, current vs 5m ago
metrics.call_oi_change: Σ ΔOI of CE in focus zone

all_of: PULLBACK: low of one of last 3 candles touched or came within 0.1% of EMA9
RECLAIM: current candle close > prev close AND close > (H+L)/2
option liquidity: spread <= 2% of mid, OI >= 10000, delta >= 0.45
PULLBACK: high of one of last 3 candles touched or came within 0.1% of EMA9
RECLAIM: current candle close < prev close AND close < (H+L)/2
option liquidity: spread <= 2% of mid, OI >= 10000, delta >= 0.45

strike_selection.dte_spread_switch: convert to 1-wide debit spread if DTE <= 3

stop_loss.comment: Picks the nearer of the two to bound risk; bounded SL keeps sizing stable

exits.partial_50pct_on: TWO consecutive 5m closes against trade direction below/above EMA9
final_exit_any_of: price crosses VWAP against trade direction (closed basis)
